name: Sleep
source:
You can't sleep. Time to see what you can do to become tired enough to fall asleep, but you better make the right choices the first time.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/sleep.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
你睡不着。是时候看看你能做些什么来让自己变得足够累而入睡，但你最好第一次就做出正确的选择。

[来自[url=http://renai.us/game/sleep.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
